title: Guest Pass Entitlements Across the Summit Club Range
content:
One-time guest passes granted with the Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships, and the terms attached to them.

| Membership | Guest passes granted at the start of each membership year | Calendar months a granted pass stays valid | Pass may admit its holder without the member present | Unused passes forfeited when the membership lapses or is cancelled |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Club Essential | 0 | 12 | No | Yes |
| Summit Club Individual | 4 | 12 | No | Yes |
| Summit Club Individual Plus | 0 | 12 | No | Yes |
| Summit Club Executive | 8 | 12 | Yes | Yes |
| Summit Club Corporate | 0 | 12 | No | Yes |
| Summit Club Lifetime | 12 | 12 | Yes | Yes |

## Terms questions answered from the table

**Which memberships receive guest passes?**
Summit Club Individual (4 a year), Summit Club Executive (8 a year) and Summit Club Lifetime (12 a year). Summit Club Essential, Summit Club Individual Plus and Summit Club Corporate are granted 0.

**How long does a granted pass stay valid?**
12 calendar months after the grant, on every membership.

**Can a pass be used by a guest arriving without the member?**
Only on Summit Club Executive and Summit Club Lifetime. On the other memberships the pass does not admit its holder without the member.

**What happens to unused passes when the membership lapses or is cancelled?**
On every membership in the range, unused passes are forfeited.
